items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only site-factory execution. The strongest validated launch candidate is driveford.net, a scaffold with a documented site-factory build opportunity, but its launch-readiness prerequisite and execution-owner evidence are incomplete. Preserve a bounded launch package covering site brief, reusable template, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics/affiliate readiness, compliance checklist, and preview-only launch gate. Do not add domains, spend, deploy, launch, or claim telemetry. Exactly one next step: continue the existing driveford.net owner-gap verification and attach dated evidence of an assigned execution owner.
